classes.name: scheme
classes.label: scheme
classes.definition: structure or means of organizing information such as a blueprint, schema, numbering system, organization structure, measurement system, plan, taxonomy, or language for organizing information

classes.name: appraisal
classes.label: appraisal
classes.definition: written estimate of the market value of something as of some point in time, typically provided by a qualified appraiser

classes.name: appraised value
classes.label: appraised value
classes.definition: estimated value of some asset as of a given point in time

classes.name: appraiser
classes.label: appraiser
classes.definition: party that evaluates or estimates the nature, quality, ability, or value of someone or something

classes.name: assessment activity
classes.label: assessment activity
classes.definition: activity involving the evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, ability, or value of someone or something

classes.name: assessment event
classes.label: assessment event
classes.definition: event involving the evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something

classes.name: assessment report
classes.label: assessment report
classes.definition: report that includes an opinion, judgement, appraisal, or view about something and typically the methodology and raw inputs used to arrive at that opinion

classes.name: expected value
classes.label: expected value
classes.definition: theoretical value that is anticipated based on a model or hypothesis

classes.name: fair value
classes.label: fair value
classes.definition: price that would be received to sell an asset, or paid to transfer a liability, in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date

classes.name: market value
classes.label: market value
classes.definition: price an asset would sell for in the market

classes.name: observed value
classes.label: observed value
classes.definition: value that is an actual data point collected from an experiment, survey, or observation

classes.name: opinion
classes.label: opinion
classes.definition: judgement, appraisal, or view about something

classes.name: present value
classes.label: present value
classes.definition: value of an asset today, which may be calculated from reference data and may based on its expected future value

classes.name: qualitative value
classes.label: qualitative value
classes.definition: value that has less precision or accuracy than a value determined via quantitative methods and which is usually expressed in codes rather than actual numbers

classes.name: quantitative value
classes.label: quantitative value
classes.definition: value determined via quantitative methods, expressed as a numerical value in appropriate units

classes.name: reference value
classes.label: reference value
classes.definition: value for something discernible for which evidence can be obtained

classes.name: valuation method
classes.label: valuation method
classes.definition: method used to determine the present or expected worth of an asset

classes.name: value
classes.label: value
classes.definition: perceived worth of something, such as a product, service, or asset to a company, customer, or stakeholder

classes.name: value assessment
classes.label: value assessment
classes.definition: assessment event to estimate the value of something

classes.name: industry sector classification scheme
classes.label: industry sector classification scheme
classes.definition: system for allocating classifiers to organizations by industry sector

classes.name: industry sector classifier
classes.label: industry sector classifier

classes.name: financial record
classes.label: financial record
classes.definition: record of financial information

classes.name: index
classes.label: index
classes.definition: indirect shortcut derived from and pointing into, a greater volume of values, data, information or knowledge

classes.name: indexing scheme
classes.label: indexing scheme
classes.definition: system for indexing values, data, information, or knowledge

classes.name: reassignable identifier
classes.label: reassignable identifier
classes.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies something for a given time period, and that may be reused to identify something else at a different point in time

classes.name: lifecycle
classes.label: lifecycle
classes.definition: arrangement that compares the cyclical nature of families, organizations, processes, products, marketing, and order management, portfolio management or other systems with the cradle to grave life stages (birth, growth, maturity, decay, and death) of living organisms

classes.name: lifecycle event
classes.label: lifecycle event
classes.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of a lifecycle

classes.name: lifecycle event occurrence
classes.label: lifecycle event occurrence

classes.name: lifecycle occurrence
classes.label: lifecycle occurrence
classes.definition: realization of a lifecycle

classes.name: lifecycle stage
classes.label: lifecycle stage
classes.definition: phase in a lifecycle

classes.name: lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.label: lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.definition: realization of a phase in a given lifecycle

classes.name: lifecycle status
classes.label: lifecycle status
classes.definition: classifier indicating the position or state of something at a particular point in its life-cycle

classes.name: qualitative rating score
classes.label: qualitative rating score
classes.definition: rating score that is represented as a qualitative code with respect to some rating scale

classes.name: quantitative rating score
classes.label: quantitative rating score
classes.definition: rating score that is a simple numeric value on some scale, such as a credit rating for an individual

classes.name: rating
classes.label: rating
classes.definition: standing of something at a particular time, indicated by at least one scores with respect to some scale, based on an assessment by some party

classes.name: rating agency
classes.label: rating agency
classes.definition: rating issuer that is also a rating scale publisher, frequently but not always an independent rating service

classes.name: rating assessment activity
classes.label: rating assessment activity
classes.definition: assessment activity resulting in a grade or score and potentially a report describing the score and the process used to determine that score

classes.name: rating assessment event
classes.label: rating assessment event
classes.definition: individual assessment resulting in a grade or score and potentially a report describing the score

classes.name: rating issuer
classes.label: rating issuer
classes.definition: party that is responsible for issuing ratings

classes.name: rating party
classes.label: rating party
classes.definition: person, organization or group that analyzes some aspect of something and develops a rating

classes.name: rating report
classes.label: rating report
classes.definition: report describing a set of ratings

classes.name: rating scale
classes.label: rating scale
classes.definition: system for assigning a value to something according to some scale with respect to quality, a standard, or ranking

classes.name: rating scale publisher
classes.label: rating scale publisher
classes.definition: party responsible for managing one or more rating schemes and potentially publishing ratings based on those schemes

classes.name: rating score
classes.label: rating score
classes.definition: grade, classification, or ranking of for something in accordance with some rating scale

classes.name: report
classes.label: report
classes.definition: document that provides a structured description of something, prepared on ad hoc, periodic, recurring, regular, or as required basis

classes.name: reporting party
classes.label: reporting party
classes.definition: party providing a report, typically in response to some contractual, legal, regulatory or other business requirement

classes.name: request
classes.label: request
classes.definition: event in which some party asks another party for something at some point in time

classes.name: request activity
classes.label: request activity
classes.definition: activity in which some party asks another party for something or to do something

classes.name: requester
classes.label: requester
classes.definition: party that asks for something

classes.name: submitter
classes.label: submitter
classes.definition: party presenting something, such as a regulatory report

edges.name: applies methodology

edges.name: estimates value at

edges.name: has appraiser

edges.name: has date of assessment
edges.label: has date of assessment

edges.name: has estimated value

edges.name: is estimated value of

edges.name: has expiration date

edges.name: has record
edges.label: has record

edges.name: has reporting period

edges.name: has termination date
edges.label: has termination date

edges.name: is index to
edges.label: is index to
edges.definition: that to which the index refers

edges.name: has lifecycle
edges.label: has lifecycle
edges.definition: relates something, such as a product, trade, or related process, to a lifecycle that characterizes it

edges.name: has stage
edges.label: has stage
edges.definition: relates something, such as a product or trade lifecycle or related process, to a phase or stage in that lifecycle

edges.name: is lifecycle of
edges.label: is lifecycle of
edges.definition: relates a lifecycle to something it characterizes

edges.name: is stage of

edges.name: has rating
edges.label: has rating
edges.definition: indicates the rating assigned to a thing based on a grade or score according to a particular rating scale

edges.name: has rating score

edges.name: produces ratings for

edges.name: rates
edges.label: rates

edges.name: uses rating performer

edges.name: has report date
edges.label: has report date
edges.definition: date on which a report was issued

edges.name: has report date time
edges.label: has report date time
edges.definition: date and time at which a report was issued

edges.name: has request date
edges.label: has request date
edges.definition: date on which a request was made

edges.name: has request date time
edges.label: has request date time
edges.definition: date and time at which a request was made

edges.name: is reported to
edges.label: is reported to
edges.definition: indicates the party to which something is reported

edges.name: is requested by
edges.label: is requested by
edges.definition: indicates the party that asks for something

edges.name: is requested of
edges.label: is requested of
edges.definition: indicates the party that is asked for something

edges.name: is submitted by
edges.label: is submitted by
edges.definition: indicates the party that submits something

edges.name: is submitted to
edges.label: is submitted to
edges.definition: indicates the party to which something is submitted

edges.name: reports on
edges.label: reports on
edges.definition: indicates a subject matter, observation(s), assessment(s), focus or other topic of a report

edges.name: requests
edges.label: requests
edges.definition: asks for something

edges.name: submits
edges.label: submits
edges.definition: presents something (a proposal, application, report, or other document) for consideration or review

attributes.name: has collection size

attributes.label: has assignment termination date

attributes.name: has initial assignment date
